description:
☠️ The Unclaimed ☠️ 
- Guild for Cursed and Banished Players!

We are a hardcore guild that focuses on purely trying to make the leaderboards one day! We offer an active leadership and plan on being around for a long time. This guild is for players who specifically Cursed or Banished because we don’t need any help from anyone! Banished forever!

Created on 2/5/2026 🗓️

✨ Features
Self-made world boss timer via discord
Active discord chat (ask any questions you have!)

✅Requirements
Participate in raids
Be active & grow your character!
Help fulfill guild challenges!

🗓️Raid Schedule
19:00 PM CET 
21:00 PM CET 
We have dynamic raids to accommodate the event boss!

💬 Discord
Discord will soon be mandatory. Please use the 'applications' channel in discord to apply.
Discord server link: https://discord.gg/Ef8b5SvaC

Welcome to The Unclaimed. We are recruiting! Simply apply on discord and let's work to become on the leaderboards!
